headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an overall effect size of 0.69 (95% CI: 0.59–0.82), suggesting that plant protein intake is associated with a lower risk of kidney and renal pelvis cancer. These findings were supported by low between-study heterogeneity (I² = 1.29%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
